A mixture of macrolide antibiotics produced by a strain of Streptomyces fradiae or by any other means. The main component of the mixture is tylosin A, but tylosin B (desmy- cosin), tylosin C (macrocin), and tylosin D (relomycin) may also be present. An almost white or slightly yellow powder. Slightly soluble in water; freely soluble in dehydrated alcohol and in dichloromethane. It dissolves in dilute solutions of mineral acids. A 2.5% suspension in water has a pH of 8.5 to 10.5.
